design_detail: EU-level wealth tax on the richest 0.5% (study range 1.7-3.5%)
quote_original: a wealth tax on the 0.5% richest section of the EU population helps to redress tax justice since it is working people that carry the biggest part of financing public services.
source_title: Malta could rake in €344 million in additional revenue from wealth tax and ending tax abuse
grading_note: Named support for a wealth tax on the top 0.5%, said as the Green Party's secretary-general when presenting the Greens/EFA study; the rate range comes from the study, so B and not A.

design_detail: fairer contribution from accumulated wealth (Budget 2027 position paper)
quote_original: ADPD jipproponi li jitnaqqas il-piż tat-taxxa fuq ix-xogħol u l-pensjonijiet fejn xieraq, filwaqt li jiżdied il-kontribut ġust minn min għandu ġid akkumulat u dħul minn investiment spekulattiv.
quote_en: ADPD proposes reducing the tax burden on work and pensions where appropriate, while ensuring a fairer contribution from accumulated wealth and income derived from speculative investment.
source_title: Il-Budget 2027 għandu jqiegħed il-benesseri fiċ-ċentru tal-politika ekonomika
grading_note: Calls for more tax on accumulated wealth without naming a wealth tax or a design, so C. Earlier ADPD calls for a wealth tax by name are a lead (Malta Independent, 2026-03-01, blocked to scripts).

design_detail: questions why accumulated wealth is taxed less than labour income
quote_original: Irridu diskussjoni nazzjonali serja dwar x’tip ta’ attività ekonomika għandha titħeġġeġ, skoraġġita jew  tonqos gradwalment. Hemm diversi kwistjonijiet li jridu jiġu indirizzati. Pereżempju, għaliex id-dħul mix-xogħol għandu jiġi ntaxxat aktar mill-ġid akkumulat, mill-attività finanzjarja spekulattiva, l-ispekulazzjoni fuq l-art u assi inattivi?
quote_en: why should income from labour continue carrying a disproportionate burden while wealth, speculative financial activity, land speculation and dormant assets remain comparatively undertaxed?
source_title: Proposti ta’ Father Christmas fuq it-tassazzjoni. Insult lill-intelliġenza tan-nies.
grading_note: Rhetorical question that accumulated wealth is undertaxed; no tax design named, so C.

design_detail: called for higher taxes on the rich including a wealth tax (as reported)
quote_original: This probably explains why the ADPD, Moviment Graffiti, and Momentum, have called for higher taxes for the rich, including a wealth tax.
publisher: The Malta Independent (column by Frans Camilleri)
grading_note: A columnist's statement that the party called for a wealth tax by name, with no link to the party's own text; B, upgrade when ADPD's own wording is found. Graffitti and Momentum are named in the same sentence and stay leads.
